title: ToursIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: tours.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Tours server/search-index.js, via openvibe-publishing/search-feed). The OpenVibe.Search document of a Tours page: a place to see (type place, /place/<plc_ id>, from OpenStreetMap with its kind, city and access facts), a city (type city, /city/<slug>: its Wikivoyage summary and how many places and walks it has) or a self-guided walk (type route, /routes/<rte_ id>: its stops, distance and time). Sent by the sweep at boot and on a timer; a page that left the catalogue becomes a tombstone. The sequencer (tours_index_revisions) gives an unchanged document its old revision and nothing is sent. Always visibility public and publication_state published. Facets: city, country, kind (place), stops/distance_m/duration_min (route), places/routes (city). Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type, id, revision }, visibility internal, actor service:tours.
